name: ResetTrailRing
evidence: stores 0 in the head (+8) and tail (+0xC) words of the ring DrawTrailRibbon walks

name: AddTrailPoint
evidence: adds a point to an object's trail ring (+0x60): its time from g_gameClock, its alpha, and the ribbon's two edges built from the object's frame and the camera (BuildAxisAngleMatrix); func_001721B0 calls it

name: QueueTrailRibbonDraw
evidence: clears a request record and queues DrawTrailRibbon for the object with QueueDeferredRequest

name: DrawTrailRibbon
evidence: walks a ring of 0x40 elements from head to tail, fades each by an age polynomial clamped to a range and the object's alpha, and emits two vertices per element as a strip into a vertex batch
